stories.title: Define comparison view schema and UI contract
stories.description: Define the frontend data contract for side-by-side provider comparison, including provider identity, overall score, individual measures, and relative ranking indicators. Ensure compatibility with backend EVAL-COMPARE response.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py (provider detail and evaluation orchestration patterns); GAP: No comparison schema exists; must define contract aligned to backend output.

stories.title: Implement comparison normalization and ranking logic
stories.description: Build frontend logic to normalize provider scores, compute relative strengths/weaknesses, and highlight deltas between providers across measures.
stories.evidence: GAP: No comparison logic implemented; required to transform backend scores into user-understandable comparisons.

stories.title: Build side-by-side comparison UI component
stories.description: Develop a reusable React component that renders two or more providers side-by-side with scores, measure breakdowns, and visual indicators for strengths and weaknesses.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components (existing React component patterns like ChatWindow and MessageBubble); GAP: No comparison UI exists.

stories.title: Integrate comparison UI with API and state management
stories.description: Connect the comparison component to backend EVAL-COMPARE API, handle loading, error states, and dynamic provider selection.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/App.tsx (API integration patterns); GAP: No comparison API integration exists.

stories.title: Add unit and UI tests for comparison feature
stories.description: Create tests validating schema mapping, comparison logic, rendering correctness, and edge cases (missing data, unequal measures, multiple providers).
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests and frontend test patterns; GAP: No tests for comparison feature exist.
